## Readings

### Introduction 

[Rosenbaum, P.R. & Rubin, D.B. (1983). The central role of the propensity score in observational
studies for causal effects. *Biometrika 70*(1), 41-55.](resources/Rosenbaum-Rubin-Bka83.pdf)

[Chapter 1 of *Applied Propensity Score Analysis with R*](https://psa.bryer.org/chapter-introduction.html)


### Matching

[Chapter 14 of *The Effect*](https://www.theeffectbook.net/ch-Matching.html)

### Sensitivity Analysis

[Chapter 14 The Power of a Sensitivity Analysis and Its Limit from *The Design of Observational Studies*](resources/Design_of_Observational_Studies Sensitivity_Analysis.pdf)

We will use the [`rbounds`](https://github.com/gabrielfgm/rbounds/) and [`tipr`](https://github.com/r-causal/tipr) packages this week.
